content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I need to show an analog value above 10,000 – specifically up to 12,500. The measurement capability covers 0 to 10,000. How can I expand this range? When I try to set the measurement range above 10,000, I encounter an error message.
You can try using two analog amplifiers connected in series.
Thanks for your quick answer! I had found this method already, but it results in losing the unit digit. Is there another way? Can I display, for example, '11299'?
I'm sorry, I don't quite understand your question. Could you please clarify what you mean?

From my experience, all analog blocks I know allow a maximum value of 10,000. If I want to display values like 11,299 or 12,235, where the last digit is not even, how can I do this with a gain multiplier? Is it possible to display analog values from 0 up to 12,500 including every single digit?
Sorry, I'm not sure what you're asking or what you're trying to achieve.
It's alright. Thank you for trying to help.

Hello [user_name], That is mathematically logical. If you apply scaling, intermediate values cannot be accessed. For instance, 5 multiplied by 2 is 10 and 5 multiplied by 3 is 15; you won't get a value between 11 and 14 through multiplication. Regards, [user_name] (translated with Google)
You can use the slope formula y = mx + b with arithmetic operation blocks. This allows mapping ranges like 0 – 1,000 to 0 – 12,500, or 0 – 10,000 to 0 – 12,500.

Hi, I'm also unsure if I fully understand. The resolution of the analog inputs/outputs on [product_name] is 1,000 steps. Setting more than 1,000 means you can't see every single digit. The maximum gain for an analog value is +/-10. For a higher gain, you could use two analog amplifiers, but the resolution won't improve beyond 1,000 steps. Hope this is helpful.

Thank you all. I realize now my question didn't make much sense. You can't expect precise accuracy in each digit after multiplying the initial values... Should've paid more attention in math class! Thanks again.

analysis.insight_summary: Users attempting to display analog values above 10,000 on [product_name] systems discover there are hard limitations due to the device's analog input/output resolution. Various suggestions, such as using multiple amplifiers or arithmetic scaling, do not enable the display of every possible digit within the extended range, resulting in loss of unit digit detail and user frustration for those seeking finer control.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to configure [product_name]'s analog measurement for ranges beyond 10,000 and display values up to 12,500 with full resolution, including each individual digit, especially the units.
